decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - Details of external brickwork, pointing, mortar, and bonding shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 1 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects and should be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects and should be approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the building, or the removal of any internal feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 5 - Prior to the commencement of the development a description of the steps and works to be taken and carried out in relation to the repair and alteration of the existing timber frame, including any additional elements to be inserted, shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing and the development shall thereafter be undertaken in accordance with the approved scheme.
description: Listed Building consent for internal alterations at ground floor level including formation of opening between rooms, insertion of two air bricks to outer wall, alterations to interior of existing bay window and alterations to existing fixtures.
